name: Needle WebMCP Registry
description: WebMCP tools across Needle web apps — built for 3D web development. Each entry is a web app that registers tools with the browser's AI agent via document.modelContext.

apps.name: Needle Documentation
apps.description: Every documentation page exposes semantic search over the entire Needle knowledge base: documentation, API reference, forum posts, Discord threads and source code. The same knowledge base is reachable over plain HTTP at https://search.needle.tools/api-docs.

tools.name: search-needle-knowledge-base
tools.description: Search the Needle knowledge base. Returns embedding-ranked excerpts with the URL of each source.

apps.name: Needle Mesh Baker
apps.description: Optimize 3D models in the browser: load a model, bake it to a triangle budget, compress it, compare before/after, download or publish to Needle Cloud. On capable machines it can also generate 3D models from a text prompt or an image — everything runs locally in the browser.

tools.name: get_workbench_state
tools.description: Loaded model, current settings, whether a result is ready. Call this first.

tools.name: load_model_from_url
tools.description: Fetch and load a GLB, glTF, OBJ, FBX or ZIP bundle.

tools.name: load_model_from_base64
tools.description: Load a file sent inline, up to 32 MB.

tools.name: set_bake_settings
tools.description: Change output mode, triangle budget, material mode, impostor settings.

tools.name: bake_model
tools.description: Run the bake and wait for it. Returns the full report.

tools.name: compress_baked_model
tools.description: Basis Universal compression, impostor output only.

tools.name: get_bake_report
tools.description: The report for the current result, without re-baking.

tools.name: set_workbench_layout
tools.description: Hide the settings pane, leaving the header, the tools and the two views.

tools.name: get_preview_screenshot
tools.description: Render the input model, the baked result, or both, and return them as images.

tools.name: download_baked_model
tools.description: Save the GLB to the user's downloads folder.

tools.name: upload_baked_model
tools.description: Upload to a Needle Cloud team, return a link.

tools.name: list_cloud_teams
tools.description: The teams the signed-in user belongs to, and which one is active.

tools.name: set_cloud_team
tools.description: Switch which team the workbench is working with.

tools.name: list_cloud_assets
tools.description: The active team's bakeable 3D assets.

tools.name: load_cloud_asset
tools.description: Load one of them into the workbench.

tools.name: get_baked_model_base64
tools.description: Return the GLB inline. Capped at 2 MB.

tools.name: search_needle_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search Needle's docs, API reference, forum and Discord.

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Whether this machine can generate, what the generator is doing, what a run would download.

tools.name: prepare_generation
tools.description: Download the model weights on their own, ahead of generating.

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Generate a model from a prompt and load it into the workbench.

tools.name: generate_model_from_image
tools.description: Generate a model from a picture of one object.

tools.name: continue_model
tools.description: Refine the last generation, or re-prompt the shape it found.

tools.name: abort_generation
tools.description: Stop whichever generation is running.

apps.name: Needle FastCut
apps.description: Remove image backgrounds in the browser, split sprite sheets, assemble grids and export — a natural companion to the Mesh Baker's image-to-3D generation. An agent that can open a second tab can cut a photo out here and bring the transparent PNG back.

tools.name: fastcut_list_images
tools.description: List the images and grids on the canvas, with id, name, status, size and method.

tools.name: fastcut_get_settings
tools.description: Read the current settings: method, model, output format, progress.

tools.name: fastcut_add_image
tools.description: Load an image (http(s) or data: URL) and remove its background.

tools.name: fastcut_set_method
tools.description: Choose the background-removal method: AI model, magic wand, unmult or source alpha.

tools.name: fastcut_set_output_format
tools.description: Set the export format: PNG or WebP.

tools.name: fastcut_reprocess
tools.description: Run background removal again on one image or on all of them.

tools.name: fastcut_split_sprites
tools.description: Detect separate objects in a cut-out and split them into individual images.

tools.name: fastcut_create_grid
tools.description: Add an empty grid tile that collects images into one sprite sheet.

tools.name: fastcut_add_to_grid
tools.description: Move an image into a grid so it becomes one cell of that sprite sheet.

tools.name: fastcut_export_grid
tools.description: Assemble a grid into a single sprite-sheet image and save it.

tools.name: fastcut_download
tools.description: Save results to the download folder — one tile, or everything as a ZIP.

tools.name: fastcut_get_image
tools.description: Return a finished cut-out as base64 image data.

tools.name: fastcut_remove_image
tools.description: Remove one image or grid from the canvas.

tools.name: fastcut_clear
tools.description: Remove every image and grid from the canvas.

apps.name: Needle Inspector
apps.description: DevTools for three.js and Needle Engine, as a Chrome extension. Inspect and edit the live 3D scene on any page: scene graph, materials, performance. Tools are registered dynamically from the Inspector's command set, so ask your agent what it can do on the page you have open.

tools.name: get_current_website
tools.description: Which page the Inspector is attached to.

tools.name: get_selected_object
tools.description: The currently selected scene object.

tools.name: get_edits
tools.description: The edits made in the Inspector session.
The full set is dynamic — discovered from the page at runtime.

apps.name: Needle Cloud
apps.description: Hosting and asset management for 3D web projects. WebMCP tools for searching and inspecting your hosted assets are in development.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search your hosted content.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Details about a hosted file or asset.

apps.name: This registry
apps.description: The registry website itself registers WebMCP tools: list the apps in this registry and search the Needle knowledge base.

tools.name: list_needle_webmcp_apps
tools.description: The machine-readable contents of this registry.

tools.name: search_needle_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search Needle's docs, API reference, forum and Discord.
